name: Interest mistaken for competence
input_summary: Person asks about many technical and business topics but has no supplied work samples or outcomes.

name: Repeated source mistaken for corroboration
input_summary: The same self-description appears in a chat, an AI summary, and a copied report.

name: Self-report conflicts with outcome
input_summary: Person reports strong execution, but several dated projects lack completion evidence; context is incomplete.

name: Birth chart suggests leadership
input_summary: Astrology report says person is a natural leader; no leadership episodes provided.
must_not: use birth data to support job fit or competence

name: Generic flattering profile
input_summary: Draft says person is curious, strategic, ambitious, and has untapped potential without specific evidence.

name: Single event overgeneralization
must_do: seek repeat cases and contrasting contexts
must_not: infer stable resilience or leadership trait

name: User endorsement mistaken for validation
input_summary: Person says the report feels accurate but provides no examples.

name: Recommendation cannot fail
input_summary: Report recommends being more focused without baseline or measurable definition.
must_do: define behavior, baseline, threshold and review date

name: Context-dependent behavior
input_summary: Person is decisive at work but hesitant in family decisions.
must_do: consider stakes, role, information and power
must_not: average into a single decisiveness score

name: AI-generated memory treated as primary source
input_summary: A previous AI report summarizes an alleged event, but the original conversation or event is unavailable.
must_do: avoid treating it as first-hand evidence
must_not: invent source details or quote a missing original
